decision.adoption: do not adopt as the v0.6.0 default replacement
decision.reason: The long validation candidate has a new substantive prop-continuity failure. Grid corruption and reference-background/UI leakage are additional visible regressions. Core reference identities and several simple actions survive, but runnable/faster is insufficient for replacement.
decision.scope: Only this fixed PDMD adapter plus upstream two-NFE recipe transferred onto the native Ref2VA base, default VSA/W8A8/INT8-QK, four fixed validation seeds and scenes on this Mac. Does not isolate LoRA-vs-schedule effects, establish SOL behavior, reproduce upstream FL2VA, or rule out other two-step approaches. No generation settings were tuned after inspecting validation.

performance.metric: median of four validation B/N elapsed-time ratios

scope: One accepted same-session pair per fixed scene/seed, alternating validation order. The handoff pair is the preregistered infrastructure-recovery pair, with byte-identical candidate replay; the earlier unpaired candidate and interrupted baseline are preserved and excluded from aggregate timing. same-host paired measurements, no confidence interval or repeated-run variance estimate. Calibration is excluded from validation medians. Full elapsed includes conditioning, denoise, decoding and mux overhead. Quality and adoption require separate evidence; stream decoding and RMS do not establish audio quality. Only default VSA was generated.
review_method: Non-blind sampled-frame review of every half-second and 6-fps sheet including the final frame for all eight accepted validation videos, plus listed native frames. All 148 consecutive frames in 12 post-hoc windows were inspected in contact sheets; selected native frames verify spatial detail. Not continuous playback, subjective listening, human preference testing or an exhaustive every-frame review of the complete videos.
audio_quality: Not assessed by listening or ASR.
reference_images: Not distributed; ordered hashes are recorded per case.

summary:
[reference generation] In five seconds, 99 blows a dandelion puff toward bobo; one drifting seed tickles his nose, he sneezes once, and the two share a giggle. Preserve the identities of <Subject 1> and <Subject 2> with the drawing style of <Subject 3>.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - retain the single rabbit's pink identity, long ears, yellow pinafore, pink pocket, white sleeves and shoes throughout the new action.
<Subject 2> (appears in [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - retain the single bear's brown identity, cream muzzle and ears, green shirt, yellow pocket, cream shorts and white shoes throughout the new action.
<Subject 3> (appears in [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - transfer its soft painted 2D illustration and warm outlines into the newly described scene, with the stated time-of-day lighting. Character sheets supply identity rather than multi-view staging.

detailed_description:
[Shot 1] A clean full-screen hand-drawn 2D cartoon uses the painted style of <Subject 3>. A static medium two-shot shows 99 <Subject 1> on the left and bobo <Subject 2> on the right, from their knees up with both complete heads, ears and hands visible. They face each other at arm's length in a sunny meadow, with softly painted flowers and distant hills behind them. 99 holds the thin stem of one white dandelion puff in her right hand between their faces; bobo's paws rest near his sides. During the first second she raises it near her mouth and leans forward. From about 1.0 to 2.3 seconds she blows once: white feathery seeds detach and float rightward across the gap, while the same stem remains in her hand. Bobo watches the seeds; one brushes his nose and he wrinkles his muzzle. Around 2.8 seconds bobo, with a warm medium-low youthful masculine voice (S1), makes one small comic sneeze with a brief forward head bob and audible "achoo", then straightens. From 3.4 seconds 99 lowers the now sparse dandelion stem, closes her eyes briefly in a light medium-high feminine giggle (S2), and bobo (S1) smiles back with a quiet warm chuckle. Hold the two smiling at one another through the last half second. Their feet stay planted; the gentle seed motion and sneeze carry the action. Natural nonverbal reactions only, without a spoken sentence or written text.

overall_soundscape:
A faint meadow breeze and a few distant birds remain beneath one soft blowing breath, one clearly timed small sneeze, then the rabbit's light giggle and the bear's warm chuckle.

non_diegetic_music:
N/A
cases.review_note: Both retain the characters and main action. The two-step output copies social-interface elements from the style reference. Calibration is excluded from the validation speed median.

cases.prompt:
subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is 99, the pink rabbit in <Picture 1>. Preserve the same round face, two long upright ears with darker pink inner ears, black bead eyes, tiny nose and smiling mouth, pink cheeks, small round tail, short rounded limbs and large-head chibi proportions. 99 wears the reference yellow pinafore dress with a pink front pocket over a white short-sleeved T-shirt, and white shoes.
<Subject 2> is bobo, the brown bear in <Picture 2>. Preserve the same round head, round ears with cream inner ears, cream muzzle, black bead eyes and nose, pink cheeks, small round tail, short rounded limbs and large-head chibi proportions. bobo wears the reference soft green T-shirt with a yellow chest pocket, cream shorts, and white shoes.
Each of <Picture 1> and <Picture 2> shows three views of ONE character. They define two characters in total, never six. Preserve both identities, species, colors, proportions and outfits throughout all three scenes.
<Picture 3>, <Picture 4>, <Picture 5> and <Picture 6> are STYLE references only: warm hand-drawn 2D animation, clean dark-brown outlines, softly painted backgrounds, gentle textured color, rounded cute expressions, cozy wooden interiors and lush flowering nature. Do not copy their panda, their bear design, their clothes or their on-screen interface.

summary:
A happy weekend shared by 99 and bobo, a 15-second, 16:9 animated short: waking together on a sunny morning, exercising and jogging together in a park, then sharing a picnic at sunset. Exactly one pink rabbit 99 and one brown bear bobo. Warm, tender and cheerful, with continuous character animation inside each scene.

detailed_description:
Use the reference 2D illustration style throughout, with flat drawn characters integrated into softly painted environments, subtle paper-like texture, soft sunlight and expressive simple faces. Maintain their original clothing in every scene. Three distinct scenes in chronological order, connected by clean cuts at about 5 and 10 seconds. Compose the two characters clearly, with enough space to see their actions. Modest camera movement only; let the characters perform the story.

[Shot 1, 00:00.000-00:05.000 — Sunny morning]
A cozy wooden bedroom in soft golden morning light. A window looks onto green trees; a light curtain moves gently in the breeze. 99 is on the left and bobo on the right, resting side by side under a light floral quilt on a bed with blue pillows. Their heads are visible above the quilt. They open their eyes, blink sleepily and sit upright. 99 raises both arms for a small stretch, her long ears gently bobbing. bobo stretches with a sleepy smile, then turns toward 99. They look at each other and smile warmly, ready for their weekend. The quilt naturally folds downward as they sit, revealing their original outfits. A gentle small push-in keeps both faces and their moving arms visible.

[Shot 2, 00:05.000-00:10.000 — Running in the park]
Cut to a sunlit park with a winding path, fresh green grass, flowering trees and a blue stream in the background. Show both complete bodies. 99 and bobo finish a brief warm-up, bending their knees and swinging their arms, then jog together along the path from left to right. Their feet alternate through repeated running strides with clear contact on the path, their arms swing, their bodies bounce gently, and 99's ears and dress move with the rhythm. They stay side by side, glance at each other and smile while continuing to run. A gentle sideways tracking camera keeps both in view as trees pass behind them. Cheerful exercise, not sliding motion or dancing.

[Shot 3, 00:10.000-00:15.000 — Sunset picnic]
Cut to a peaceful grassy clearing beside the stream at golden sunset, under a flowering tree. Warm peach light fills the sky and outlines the characters. 99 and bobo sit together on a cream picnic blanket, with one wicker basket, a small plate of orange slices, two sandwiches and two cups between them. 99 picks up one orange slice and offers it to bobo. bobo accepts it with one paw, smiles and takes a small bite. 99 smiles back and lifts her cup; bobo lifts his cup to meet hers in one gentle toast. They settle shoulder to shoulder looking contentedly toward the glowing sunset. A light breeze stirs the flowers and grass. End on both happy characters and their picnic in a calm wide composition.

overall_soundscape:
Soft birdsong and a gentle breeze in the morning, light rhythmic footfalls on the park path during running, quiet fabric rustles and one delicate cup clink at the picnic. No dialogue, narration, intelligible speech or vocals.

non_diegetic_music:
A gentle continuous instrumental melody with soft piano and light acoustic plucked strings, warm and cheerful, remaining soft enough to hear the small natural sounds.

negative:
No panda, extra characters, duplicate rabbit or bear, identity or outfit swapping, character transformation, photorealism, 3D rendering, plush-toy material, character sheets, split screens, panels, montage of still pictures, frozen running poses, sliding feet, malformed limbs or extra ears. No text, Chinese labels, subtitles, speech bubbles, numbers, logos, watermarks, profile avatars, social-media buttons, hearts or like counts from the style screenshots. Do not reproduce any screenshot as a video frame.
cases.review_note: Both retain the three scenes and main character designs. In the two-step output, running has grid-like breakup; around 12.0–12.5 s, the offered orange slice duplicates and the rabbit’s remaining slice becomes an extra cup.
